# Helper Functions

```{r Helper Functions}
#' Apply a trained cv.glmnet signature to a new sample matrix.
#'
#' @param model      A fitted cv.glmnet object.
#' @param new_data   A samples-x-genes matrix for the new samples.
#' @param true_labels Optional vector of known labels (same order as new_data rows).
#'                    If provided, adds `true` and `correct` columns.
#' @param sig_genes  Optional character vector of signature gene names. If NULL,
#'                   non-zero coefficients at `s` are used automatically.
#' @param s          Lambda value passed to predict(); default "lambda.1se".
#' @param timepoint  Optional string label added as a `timepoint` column (e.g. "W2").
#'
#' @return A data frame with columns: [timepoint,] sample, [true,] predicted, prob_S [, correct].
apply_signature <- function(model, new_data, true_labels = NULL,
                             sig_genes = NULL, s = "lambda.1se",
                             timepoint = NULL) {
  # Extract non-zero signature genes from the model if not supplied
  if (is.null(sig_genes)) {
    coefs     <- coef(model, s = s)
    sig_genes <- rownames(coefs)[coefs[, 1] != 0 & rownames(coefs) != "(Intercept)"]
    if (length(sig_genes) == 0)
      stop("No non-zero coefficients found at s = '", s, "'. Try s = 'lambda.min'.")
  }

  shared <- intersect(sig_genes, colnames(new_data))
  if (length(shared) == 0)
    stop("None of the signature genes are present in new_data columns.")
  if (length(shared) < length(sig_genes))
    message(length(sig_genes) - length(shared),
            " signature gene(s) absent from new_data; scoring with ",
            length(shared), " genes.")

  x_new <- new_data[, shared, drop = FALSE]

  pred_class <- predict(model, x_new, s = s, type = "class")[, 1]
  pred_prob  <- round(predict(model, x_new, s = s, type = "response")[, 1], 3)

  result <- data.frame(
    sample    = rownames(x_new),
    predicted = pred_class,
    prob_S    = pred_prob,
    row.names = NULL,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (!is.null(true_labels)) {
    result$true    <- as.character(true_labels)
    result$correct <- as.integer(pred_class == result$true)
    result <- result[, c("sample", "true", "predicted", "prob_S", "correct")]
  }

  if (!is.null(timepoint))
    result <- cbind(timepoint = timepoint, result)

  result
}
```

# Data Loading and Filtering

```{r Load Data}
#read in count data ----
data <- read.delim("rsem.merged.gene_counts.annot.tsv", 
                   row.names = NULL)

# Deal with genes that don't have annotated gene symbols (external_gene_name)
# Use ENSEMBL ID if gene symbol not available
data$external_gene_name <- ifelse(data$external_gene_name == ".",
  data$gene_id,
  data$external_gene_name
)

# Deal with duplicated gene symbols
# Combine gene symbol with ENSEMBL ID if non-unique
data$external_gene_name <- ifelse(duplicated(data$external_gene_name),
  paste(data$external_gene_name, data$gene_id, sep="_"),
  data$external_gene_name
)

# Then we can use the gene symbol column as the row names,
# and subset the count data for further analysis
rownames(data) <- data$external_gene_name
count.data <- data[,6:ncol(data)] # All columns after 5 are count data
gene_info = data[,1:5] # Columns with gene names and description 

#just leave number in sample name 
#colnames(count.data) <- sub("X15680.RP.", "", colnames(count.data))

#sample information
#read information about samples provided by AGC
info_file1= read.csv('DemuxStats_15680-RP.csv', 
                     check.names=FALSE,header=T, sep=",")

# Created a new column to match column names in raw data
info_file1$Sample_name = make.names(info_file1$Sample_ID)

# Verify that the order of count.data matches info_file1
info_file1$Sample_name == colnames(count.data)
sum(info_file1$Sample_name == colnames(count.data)) # ensure all 64 samples are true

# Rename the columns of count.data to be my naming convention
colnames(count.data) = info_file1$Description

```

```{r Filter Samples}
data_filt <- count.data[rowSums(count.data)>0,] # Remove 0 expression genes

#Remove genes Gm- or -Rik or -ps or ENSMUS-
data_filt1 = data_filt[!grepl("^Gm|Rik$|Rik[0-9]+$|-ps[0-9]+$|-ps$|^ENSMUS", rownames(data_filt)),] 

# Remove low expression genes
filt_low <- 10
keep1 <- rowSums(data_filt1) > (filt_low * 26) # Low count filter, required
data_filt1 <- data_filt1[keep1,] # Apply filter to counts data
dim(data_filt1) # Dimensions after applying low filter

```

# UT D18 Signature Generation

```{r DESeq2 - UT D18}
# Subset UT samples from D18
ut_SandNS_D18 <- data_filt1 %>% dplyr::select(matches("^UT_(S|NS).*_D18$"))
ut_SandNS_D18 <- round(ut_SandNS_D18,0) # Make all counts integers

# Second dataframe with the condition for each UT D18 sample
coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(ut_SandNS_D18), 
                      condition = ifelse(grepl("UT_S", colnames(ut_SandNS_D18)), "S", "NS"))

# Set the condition as a factor (a datatype) and list NS first so it's the baseline comparison, which is more intuitive
coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition, levels = c("NS", "S"))

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = ut_SandNS_D18,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ condition
)

dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 10, ]

dds <- DESeq(dds)

resultsNames(dds)
res <- results(dds, pAdjustMethod = "none")

summary(res)

# Order by adjusted p-value, which is the same as the p-value if the pAdjustMethod = none above
res_ordered <- res[order(res$padj), ]
view(res_ordered %>% data.frame())

# Shrink log2FC
resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="condition_S_vs_NS", type="apeglm")

# Visualize!
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)

ggplot(res_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1) 

LFc = 1 #logfold change cutoff for DEGs
pc = 0.05 #pvalue cutoff for DEGs

# Subset results by log2FC > |1| and pval < 0.07 
upUT_S_D18 <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$pvalue) & res_df$pvalue < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange > 1,]
dnUT_S_D18 <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$pvalue) & res_df$pvalue < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange < -1,]
degUT_D18 <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$pvalue) & res_df$pvalue < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 1,]

```

```{r Elastic Net Signature Generation - UT D18}
set.seed(7823) # Keep the seed consistent for reproducibility

# Using all genes (not just DEGs) was unsuccessful, so filter to just DEGs to improve the model
x <- t(as.matrix(ut_SandNS_D18)) # now: 12 x genes
deg_genes <- rownames(degUT_D18)
x_deg <- x[, colnames(x) %in% deg_genes, drop = FALSE]

y <- coldata$condition # factor: "NS" (reference) vs "S"

n <- nrow(x_deg)

# Initialize empty vectors for the for loop
gene_freq <- setNames(rep(0L, ncol(x_deg)), colnames(x_deg))
gene_list <- vector("list", n)
accuracy_vec <- rep(NA_real_, n)

# LOOCV: leave one sample out per iteration
for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  print(i)
  
  # Leave sample i out
   x_tr <- x_deg[-i, , drop = FALSE]
   y_tr <- y[-i]
   x_lo <- x_deg[i, , drop = FALSE]
   y_lo <- y[i]
  
  # # Random partition of dataset (~2/3 train per class)
  # train_index <- sample(1:6, 4)
  # train_index <- append(train_index, (sample(7:12, 4)))
  # 
  # x_train <- x[train_index,]
  # y_train <- coldata[train_index,]
  # x_test <- x[-train_index,]
  # y_test <- coldata[-train_index,]
  
  # cv.glmnet: LOOCV to choose lambda
  # Could add suppressWarnings( before cv.glmnet() if you don't want to see warnings
  cvfit <- cv.glmnet(x_tr, y_tr, 
                     family = "binomial",
                     alpha  = 0.5,        
                     nfolds = nrow(x_tr), # LOOCV for small n
                     type.measure = "class")
  
  # Record selected genes (lambda.min -> lowest CV error to retain more genes)
  coef_mat <- coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.1se")
  selected <- rownames(coef_mat)[coef_mat[, 1] != 0 & 
                                   rownames(coef_mat) != "(Intercept)"]
  gene_list[[i]] <- selected
  gene_freq[selected] <- gene_freq[selected] + 1L
  
  # Correct (1) or incorrect (0) for the left-out sample
  pred_class <- predict(cvfit, x_lo, s = "lambda.1se", type = "class")[, 1]
  accuracy_vec[i] <- as.integer(pred_class == as.character(y_lo))
}

# Gene selection frequency
gene_freq_df <- data.frame(
gene         = names(gene_freq),
n_selected   = as.integer(gene_freq),
pct_selected = round(as.integer(gene_freq) / n * 100, 1)) |>
dplyr::arrange(desc(n_selected))

# Signature: genes selected in >= 60% of runs
signature_genes <- gene_freq_df$gene[gene_freq_df$pct_selected >= 60]
cat("Signature size (>= 60% selection frequency):", length(signature_genes), "\n")

# Print final signature
cat("\nFinal gene signature:\n")
print(signature_genes)
cat("\nPrediction accuracy for left-out sample:\n")
print(sum(accuracy_vec)/n*100)

```

``` {r Heatmap of UT D18 Signature}

# Subset to signature genes and UT samples
heat_mat <- vst_mat[signature_genes, colnames(ut_SandNS_D18)]

# Annotation bar for condition

pheatmap(heat_mat,

```

  # Record selected genes (lambda.min -> lowest CV error to retain more genes)

# Signature Application - UT D18 to T D18

``` {r Apply UT D18 Signature to T D18 Samples}
# Retrain a final model on D18 UT samples using only the UT signature genes
x_ut_sig <- x[, colnames(x) %in% signature_genes, drop = FALSE]

ut_final_fit <- cv.glmnet(x_ut_sig, y,
                           family       = "binomial",
                           alpha        = 0.5,
                           nfolds       = nrow(x_ut_sig),  # LOOCV
                           type.measure = "class")

# Subset T samples to the same signature genes
shared_genes  <- intersect(signature_genes, colnames(x_t))
x_t_sig       <- x_t[, shared_genes, drop = FALSE]

# Predict S vs NS in T samples
T_pred_class <- predict(ut_final_fit, x_t_sig, s = "lambda.1se", type = "class")[, 1]
T_pred_prob  <- predict(ut_final_fit, x_t_sig, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")[, 1]

# Accuracy against known T labels
T_pred_correct <- as.integer(T_pred_class == as.character(y_t))

T_pred_df <- data.frame(sample    = rownames(x_t_sig),
                        true      = as.character(y_t),
                        predicted = T_pred_class,
                        prob_S    = round(T_pred_prob, 3),
                        correct   = T_pred_correct)

cat("UT signature genes used:    ", length(signature_genes), "\n")
cat("Genes found in T matrix:    ", length(shared_genes), "\n\n")
cat("Predicted classes (T samples):\n")
print(T_pred_df)
cat("\nAccuracy of UT signature on T samples:", round(mean(T_pred_correct) * 100, 1), "%\n")

# Determine number of predicted non-survivors that became survivors because of NPs
np_benefit_df <- T_pred_df[T_pred_df$true == "S",]
np_benefit <- sum(T_pred_correct == FALSE & y_t == "S")/nrow(np_benefit_df)
cat("Percent of mice that benefitted from NPs:", round(np_benefit * 100, 1), "%\n")

# Accuracy of the model for T NS samples
np_ns_df <- T_pred_df[T_pred_df$true == "NS",]
np_ns <- sum(T_pred_correct == TRUE & y_t == "NS")/nrow(np_ns_df)
print(np_ns_df)
cat("Accuracy of the model for T NS samples:", round(np_ns * 100, 1), "%\n")

```

# 17-Sample Signature Generation

``` {r New Model: UT D18 + T NS D18 Samples}
# T NS mice died despite NP treatment, making their NS status unambiguous.
# Adding them to the UT training set expands NS representation (6 -> 11 samples)
# without label ambiguity, since their outcome is independent of NP benefit.
# Note: at D18, mice have not yet received NPs, so T and UT samples are biologically identical.

set.seed(7823)

# --- Build combined training matrix ---
# Extract T NS samples and filter to UT DEG features
t_ns_idx   <- which(y_t == "NS")
x_t_ns_deg <- x_t[t_ns_idx, colnames(x_t) %in% deg_genes, drop = FALSE]

# Combine UT (12 samples) + T NS (5 samples)
x_combined <- rbind(x_deg, x_t_ns_deg)
y_combined <- factor(c(as.character(y), rep("NS", nrow(x_t_ns_deg))),
                     levels = c("NS", "S"))

cat("Combined training set:\n")
print(table(y_combined))
cat("Feature count:", ncol(x_combined), "\n\n")

# --- LOOCV on combined training set ---
n_comb         <- nrow(x_combined)
gene_freq_comb <- setNames(rep(0L, ncol(x_combined)), colnames(x_combined))
gene_list_comb <- vector("list", n_comb)
accuracy_comb  <- rep(NA_real_, n_comb)

for (i in seq_len(n_comb)) {
  x_tr <- x_combined[-i, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tr <- y_combined[-i]
  x_lo <- x_combined[i,  , drop = FALSE]
  y_lo <- y_combined[i]

  # Recompute weights per fold so they reflect the actual training class counts
  n_ns_tr <- sum(y_tr == "NS")
  n_s_tr  <- sum(y_tr == "S")
  w_tr    <- ifelse(y_tr == "NS", 1 / n_ns_tr, 1 / n_s_tr)

  cvfit_c <- cv.glmnet(x_tr, y_tr,
                       weights      = w_tr,
                       family       = "binomial",
                       alpha        = 0.5,
                       nfolds       = nrow(x_tr), # LOOCV for small n
                       type.measure = "class")

  coef_c     <- coef(cvfit_c, s = "lambda.1se")
  selected_c <- rownames(coef_c)[coef_c[, 1] != 0 & rownames(coef_c) != "(Intercept)"]
  gene_list_comb[[i]] <- selected_c
  gene_freq_comb[selected_c] <- gene_freq_comb[selected_c] + 1L

  pred_c        <- predict(cvfit_c, x_lo, s = "lambda.1se", type = "class")[, 1]
  accuracy_comb[i] <- as.integer(pred_c == as.character(y_lo))
}

# Gene selection frequency
gene_freq_comb_df <- data.frame(
  gene         = names(gene_freq_comb),
  n_selected   = as.integer(gene_freq_comb),
  pct_selected = round(as.integer(gene_freq_comb) / n_comb * 100, 1)
) |> dplyr::arrange(desc(n_selected))

# Signature: genes selected in >= 60% of LOOCV runs
signature_genes_comb <- gene_freq_comb_df$gene[gene_freq_comb_df$pct_selected >= 60]

# Per-sample LOOCV results
loocv_comb_df <- data.frame(
  sample  = rownames(x_combined),
  true    = as.character(y_combined),
  correct = accuracy_comb
)

cat("=== Combined LOOCV Results ===\n")
cat("Overall accuracy:", round(sum(accuracy_comb) / n_comb * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("NS accuracy:     ", round(mean(accuracy_comb[y_combined == "NS"]) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("S  accuracy:     ", round(mean(accuracy_comb[y_combined == "S"])  * 100, 1), "%\n\n")
print(loocv_comb_df)
cat("\nSignature size (>= 60% selection frequency):", length(signature_genes_comb), "\n")
print(signature_genes_comb)

# --- Retrain final model on all 17 combined samples ---
x_comb_sig <- x_combined[, colnames(x_combined) %in% signature_genes_comb, drop = FALSE]

# Weights inversely proportional to class frequency to correct for 11 NS vs 6 S imbalance
n_ns <- sum(y_combined == "NS")
n_s  <- sum(y_combined == "S")
w_combined <- ifelse(y_combined == "NS", 1 / n_ns, 1 / n_s)

final_fit_comb <- cv.glmnet(x_comb_sig, y_combined,
                             weights      = w_combined,
                             family       = "binomial",
                             alpha        = 0.5,
                             nfolds       = nrow(x_comb_sig),
                             type.measure = "class")

# Apply to T S samples only (T NS were part of the training set)
t_s_idx   <- which(y_t == "S")
x_t_s_sig <- x_t[t_s_idx, colnames(x_t) %in% signature_genes_comb, drop = FALSE]

T_S_pred_class <- predict(final_fit_comb, x_t_s_sig, s = "lambda.1se", type = "class")[, 1]
T_S_pred_prob  <- predict(final_fit_comb, x_t_s_sig, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")[, 1]

T_S_pred_df <- data.frame(
  sample    = rownames(x_t_s_sig),
  predicted = T_S_pred_class,
  prob_S    = round(T_S_pred_prob, 3)
)

cat("\n=== Predictions for T Survivor Samples ===\n")
cat("(T NS samples were in training — see LOOCV above for their performance)\n\n")
print(T_S_pred_df)

# T S mice predicted as NS = mice whose D18 profile looked like NS but survived -> NP benefit
np_benefit_comb <- sum(T_S_pred_class == "NS") / nrow(T_S_pred_df)
cat("\nT S mice predicted as NS (potential NP benefit):",
    sum(T_S_pred_class == "NS"), "/", nrow(T_S_pred_df),
    paste0("(", round(np_benefit_comb * 100, 1), "%)\n"))

```

```{r Rerun DESeq2 on all 17 training samples}
# Subset T NS samples from D18
T_NS_D18 <- data_filt1 %>% dplyr::select(matches("^T_NS.*_D18$"))
T_NS_D18 <- round(T_NS_D18, 0) # Make all counts integers

comb_samples <- cbind(T_NS_D18, ut_SandNS_D18)

# Second dataframe with the condition for each T D18 sample
comb_coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(comb_samples), 
                           condition = ifelse(grepl("NS", colnames(comb_samples)), "NS", "S"),
                           treatment = ifelse(grepl("UT", colnames(comb_samples)),"UT", "T"))

# Set the condition as a factor (a datatype) and list NS first so it's the baseline comparison, which is more intuitive
comb_coldata$condition <- factor(comb_coldata$condition, levels = c("NS", "S"))

# c_ = combined
c_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = comb_samples,
  colData = comb_coldata,
  design = ~ treatment + condition)

c_dds <- c_dds[rowSums(counts(c_dds)) > 10, ]

c_dds <- DESeq(c_dds)

resultsNames(c_dds)
c_res <- results(c_dds, pAdjustMethod = "none")

summary(c_res)

# Order by adjusted p-value, which is the same as the p-value if the pAdjustMethod = none above
c_res_ordered <- c_res[order(c_res$padj), ]
view(c_res_ordered %>% data.frame())

# Shrink log2FC
c_resLFC <- lfcShrink(c_dds, coef="condition_S_vs_NS", type="apeglm")

# Visualize!
c_res_df <- as.data.frame(c_res)

ggplot(c_res_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1) +
  xlim(-6,5)

c_deg_genes <- c_res_df[!is.na(c_res_df$pvalue) & c_res_df$pvalue < 0.05 & abs(c_res_df$log2FoldChange) > 1,]
```


``` {r New Model Update: UT D18 + T NS D18 Samples with DEGs from all 17}
# The "new" model was originally based on DEGs found between all UT samples. Now, we use DEGs found between all 17 samples (including the T NS samples) in the new model. 

set.seed(7823)

# --- Build combined training matrix ---
# Filter to combined DEG features
x_comb <- t(as.matrix(comb_samples)) 
x_comb_deg <- x_comb[,colnames(x_comb) %in% rownames(c_deg_genes), drop = FALSE]

y_comb <- factor(comb_coldata$condition)

cat("Combined training set:\n")
print(table(y_comb))
cat("Feature count:", ncol(x_comb_deg), "\n\n")

# --- LOOCV on combined training set ---
n_comb2         <- nrow(x_comb_deg)
gene_freq_comb2 <- setNames(rep(0L, ncol(x_comb_deg)), colnames(x_comb_deg))
gene_list_comb2 <- vector("list", n_comb2)
accuracy_comb2  <- rep(NA_real_, n_comb2)

for (i in seq_len(n_comb2)) {
  x_tr2 <- x_comb_deg[-i, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tr2 <- y_comb[-i]
  x_lo2 <- x_comb_deg[i,  , drop = FALSE]
  y_lo2 <- y_comb[i]

  # Recompute weights per fold so they reflect the actual training class counts
  n_ns_tr2 <- sum(y_tr2 == "NS")
  n_s_tr2  <- sum(y_tr2 == "S")
  w_tr2    <- ifelse(y_tr2 == "NS", 1 / n_ns_tr2, 1 / n_s_tr2)

  cvfit_c2 <- cv.glmnet(x_tr2, y_tr2,
                       weights      = w_tr2,
                       family       = "binomial",
                       alpha        = 0.5,
                       nfolds       = nrow(x_tr2), # LOOCV for small n
                       type.measure = "class")

  coef_c2     <- coef(cvfit_c2, s = "lambda.1se")
  selected_c2 <- rownames(coef_c2)[coef_c2[, 1] != 0 & rownames(coef_c2) != "(Intercept)"]
  gene_list_comb2[[i]] <- selected_c2
  gene_freq_comb2[selected_c2] <- gene_freq_comb2[selected_c2] + 1L

  pred_c2        <- predict(cvfit_c2, x_lo2, s = "lambda.1se", type = "class")[, 1]
  accuracy_comb2[i] <- as.integer(pred_c2 == as.character(y_lo2))
}

# Gene selection frequency
gene_freq_comb_df2 <- data.frame(
  gene         = names(gene_freq_comb2),
  n_selected   = as.integer(gene_freq_comb2),
  pct_selected = round(as.integer(gene_freq_comb2) / n_comb2 * 100, 1)
) |> dplyr::arrange(desc(n_selected))

# Signature: genes selected in >= 60% of LOOCV runs
signature_genes_comb2 <- gene_freq_comb_df2$gene[gene_freq_comb_df2$pct_selected >= 60]

# Per-sample LOOCV results
loocv_comb_df2 <- data.frame(
  sample  = rownames(x_comb_deg),
  true    = as.character(y_comb),
  correct = accuracy_comb2
)

cat("=== Combined LOOCV Results ===\n")
cat("Overall accuracy:", round(sum(accuracy_comb2) / n_comb2 * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("NS accuracy:     ", round(mean(accuracy_comb2[y_comb == "NS"]) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("S  accuracy:     ", round(mean(accuracy_comb2[y_comb == "S"])  * 100, 1), "%\n\n")
print(loocv_comb_df2)
cat("\nSignature size (>= 60% selection frequency):", length(signature_genes_comb2), "\n")
print(signature_genes_comb2)

# --- Retrain final model on all 17 combined samples ---
x_comb_sig2 <- x_comb[, colnames(x_comb) %in% signature_genes_comb2, drop = FALSE]

# Weights inversely proportional to class frequency to correct for 11 NS vs 6 S imbalance
n_ns2 <- sum(y_comb == "NS")
n_s2  <- sum(y_comb == "S")
w_combined2 <- ifelse(y_comb == "NS", 1 / n_ns2, 1 / n_s2)

final_fit_comb2 <- cv.glmnet(x_comb_sig2, y_comb,
                             weights      = w_combined2,
                             family       = "binomial",
                             alpha        = 0.5,
                             nfolds       = nrow(x_comb_sig2),
                             type.measure = "class")

# Apply to T S samples only (T NS were part of the training set)
x_t_s_sig2 <- x_t[t_s_idx, colnames(x_t) %in% signature_genes_comb2, drop = FALSE]

T_S_pred_class2 <- predict(final_fit_comb2, x_t_s_sig2, s = "lambda.1se", type = "class")[, 1]
T_S_pred_prob2  <- predict(final_fit_comb2, x_t_s_sig2, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")[, 1]

T_S_pred_df2 <- data.frame(
  sample    = rownames(x_t_s_sig2),
  predicted = T_S_pred_class2,
  prob_S    = round(T_S_pred_prob2, 3)
)

cat("\n=== Predictions for T Survivor Samples ===\n")

print(T_S_pred_df2)

# T S mice predicted as NS = mice whose D18 profile looked like NS but survived -> NP benefit

cat("\nAccuracy of T D18 signature on T W2 samples:", round(mean(T_W2_pred_correct) * 100, 1), "%\n")

n_T_W2 <- nrow(x_T_W2_deg)

cat("Combined training set:\n")
print(table(y_T_W2))
cat("Feature count:", ncol(x_T_W2_deg), "\n\n")

# --- LOOCV on combined training set ---
n_T_W2         <- nrow(x_T_W2_deg)
gene_freq_T_W2 <- setNames(rep(0L, ncol(x_T_W2_deg)), colnames(x_T_W2_deg))
gene_list_T_W2 <- vector("list", n_T_W2)
accuracy_T_W2  <- rep(NA_real_, n_T_W2)

for (i in seq_len(n_T_W2)) {
  x_tr <- x_T_W2_deg[-i, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tr <- y_T_W2[-i]
  x_lo <- x_T_W2_deg[i,  , drop = FALSE]
  y_lo <- y_T_W2[i]

  # Recompute weights per fold so they reflect the actual training class counts
  n_ns_tr <- sum(y_tr == "NS")
  n_s_tr  <- sum(y_tr == "S")
  w_tr    <- ifelse(y_tr == "NS", 1 / n_ns_tr, 1 / n_s_tr)

  cvfit_T_W2 <- cv.glmnet(x_tr, y_tr,
                       weights      = w_tr,
                       family       = "binomial",
                       alpha        = 0.5,
                       nfolds       = nrow(x_tr), # LOOCV for small n
                       type.measure = "class")

  coef_T_W2     <- coef(cvfit_T_W2, s = "lambda.1se")
  selected_T_W2 <- rownames(coef_T_W2)[coef_T_W2[, 1] != 0 & rownames(coef_T_W2) != "(Intercept)"]
  gene_list_T_W2[[i]] <- selected_T_W2
  gene_freq_T_W2[selected_T_W2] <- gene_freq_T_W2[selected_T_W2] + 1L

  pred_T_W2        <- predict(cvfit_T_W2, x_lo, s = "lambda.1se", type = "class")[, 1]
  accuracy_T_W2[i] <- as.integer(pred_T_W2 == as.character(y_lo))
}

# Gene selection frequency
gene_freq_T_W2_df <- data.frame(
  gene         = names(gene_freq_T_W2),
  n_selected   = as.integer(gene_freq_T_W2),
  pct_selected = round(as.integer(gene_freq_T_W2) / n_T_W2 * 100, 1)
) |> dplyr::arrange(desc(n_selected))

# Signature: genes selected in >= 60% of LOOCV runs
signature_genes_T_W2 <- gene_freq_T_W2_df$gene[gene_freq_T_W2_df$pct_selected >= 60]

# Per-sample LOOCV results
loocv_T_W2_df <- data.frame(
  sample  = rownames(x_T_W2_deg),
  true    = as.character(y_T_W2),
  correct = accuracy_T_W2
)

cat("=== Combined LOOCV Results ===\n")
cat("Overall accuracy:", round(sum(accuracy_T_W2) / n_T_W2 * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("NS accuracy:     ", round(mean(accuracy_T_W2[y_T_W2 == "NS"]) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("S  accuracy:     ", round(mean(accuracy_T_W2[y_T_W2 == "S"])  * 100, 1), "%\n\n")
print(loocv_T_W2_df)
cat("\nSignature size (>= 60% selection frequency):", length(signature_genes_T_W2), "\n")
print(signature_genes_T_W2)

# --- Retrain final model on all amples ---
x_T_W2_sig <- x_T_W2_deg[, colnames(x_T_W2_deg) %in% signature_genes_T_W2, drop = FALSE]

# Weights inversely proportional to class frequency to correct for 5 NS vs 9 S imbalance
n_ns <- sum(y_T_W2 == "NS")
n_s  <- sum(y_T_W2 == "S")
w_T_W2 <- ifelse(y_T_W2 == "NS", 1 / n_ns, 1 / n_s)

final_fit_T_W2 <- cv.glmnet(x_T_W2_sig, y_T_W2,
                             weights      = w_T_W2,
                             family       = "binomial",
                             alpha        = 0.5,
                             nfolds       = nrow(x_T_W2_sig),
                             type.measure = "class")

```

# W2-Specific Signature: Stratifies T S vs T NS Across Timepoints

```{r Claude W2-Specific Signature Generation}
# Strategy: use W2 DEGs that are NOT present in D18 DEGs.
# These genes distinguish S from NS at W2 but are not significantly different at D18,
# so applying the model back to D18 should yield overlapping scores.

w2_specific_genes <- setdiff(rownames(degT_W2), rownames(degT_D18))
cat("W2-specific DEGs (not in D18 DEGs):", length(w2_specific_genes), "\n")

# Build W2 training matrix restricted to W2-specific genes
x_T_W2_specific <- x_T_W2[, colnames(x_T_W2) %in% w2_specific_genes, drop = FALSE]
y_T_W2 <- T_W2_coldata$condition  # factor: "NS" (reference) vs "S"

# ── LOOCV ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(4521)
n_W2spec <- nrow(x_T_W2_specific)

gene_freq_W2spec <- setNames(rep(0L, ncol(x_T_W2_specific)), colnames(x_T_W2_specific))

loocv_W2spec <- data.frame(
  sample    = rownames(x_T_W2_specific),
  true      = as.character(y_T_W2),
  predicted = NA_character_,
  prob_S    = NA_real_,
  correct   = NA_integer_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_len(n_W2spec)) {
  x_tr <- x_T_W2_specific[-i, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tr <- y_T_W2[-i]
  x_te <- x_T_W2_specific[i, , drop = FALSE]
  n_ns_tr <- sum(y_tr == "NS"); n_s_tr <- sum(y_tr == "S")
  w_tr <- ifelse(y_tr == "NS", 1/n_ns_tr, 1/n_s_tr)
  fit_i <- cv.glmnet(x_tr, y_tr, weights = w_tr,
                     family = "binomial", alpha = 0.5,
                     nfolds = length(y_tr), type.measure = "class")
  loocv_W2spec$predicted[i] <- predict(fit_i, x_te, s = "lambda.1se", type = "class")[1]
  loocv_W2spec$prob_S[i]    <- round(predict(fit_i, x_te, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")[1], 3)
  loocv_W2spec$correct[i]   <- as.integer(loocv_W2spec$predicted[i] == as.character(y_T_W2[i]))
  # Track which genes were selected in this fold
  selected_W2spec <- names(which(coef(fit_i, s = "lambda.1se")[-1, 1] != 0))
  gene_freq_W2spec[selected_W2spec] <- gene_freq_W2spec[selected_W2spec] + 1L
}

cat("=== LOOCV Results ===\n")
cat("Overall accuracy:", round(mean(loocv_W2spec$correct) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("NS accuracy:     ", round(mean(loocv_W2spec$correct[loocv_W2spec$true == "NS"]) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("S  accuracy:     ", round(mean(loocv_W2spec$correct[loocv_W2spec$true == "S"]) * 100, 1), "%\n\n")
print(loocv_W2spec)

# Gene selection frequency
gene_freq_W2spec_df <- data.frame(
  gene         = names(gene_freq_W2spec),
  n_selected   = as.integer(gene_freq_W2spec),
  pct_selected = round(as.integer(gene_freq_W2spec) / n_W2spec * 100, 1)
) |> dplyr::arrange(desc(pct_selected))

sig_genes_W2spec <- gene_freq_W2spec_df$gene[gene_freq_W2spec_df$pct_selected >= 60]
cat("\nSignature size (>= 60% selection frequency):", length(sig_genes_W2spec), "\n")
print(sig_genes_W2spec)

# ── Retrain final model on frequency-selected genes ──────────────────────────
x_W2spec_sig <- x_T_W2_specific[, colnames(x_T_W2_specific) %in% sig_genes_W2spec, drop = FALSE]

n_ns <- sum(y_T_W2 == "NS"); n_s <- sum(y_T_W2 == "S")
w_final <- ifelse(y_T_W2 == "NS", 1/n_ns, 1/n_s)

final_fit_W2spec <- cv.glmnet(x_W2spec_sig, y_T_W2,
                               weights      = w_final,
                               family       = "binomial",
                               alpha        = 0.5,
                               nfolds       = nrow(x_W2spec_sig),
                               type.measure = "class")
```

```{r Claude W2-Specific Signature Applied Across Timepoints}
# Apply final model to D18, W2, and W4 samples and plot prob_S trajectories

# D18
D18_shared    <- intersect(sig_genes_W2spec, colnames(T_D18))
D18_prob      <- predict(final_fit_W2spec, T_D18[, D18_shared, drop = FALSE],
                         s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")[, 1]

# W2 (scored by final model for consistency)
W2_shared     <- intersect(sig_genes_W2spec, colnames(x_T_W2))
W2_prob       <- predict(final_fit_W2spec, x_T_W2[, W2_shared, drop = FALSE],
                         s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")[, 1]

# W4
W4_shared     <- intersect(sig_genes_W2spec, colnames(T_W4))
W4_prob       <- predict(final_fit_W2spec, T_W4[, W4_shared, drop = FALSE],
                         s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")[, 1]

# Combine
df_W2spec_traj <- rbind(
  data.frame(sample = names(D18_prob), timepoint = "D18",
             condition = as.character(T_coldata$condition),    prob_S = as.numeric(D18_prob)),
  data.frame(sample = names(W2_prob),  timepoint = "W2",
             condition = as.character(T_W2_coldata$condition), prob_S = as.numeric(W2_prob)),
  data.frame(sample = names(W4_prob),  timepoint = "W4",
             condition = as.character(T_W4_coldata$condition), prob_S = as.numeric(W4_prob))
)
df_W2spec_traj$timepoint <- factor(df_W2spec_traj$timepoint, levels = c("D18", "W2", "W4"))
df_W2spec_traj$subject   <- sub("_(D18|W2|W4)$", "", df_W2spec_traj$sample)

# Group means for bolded summary lines
df_W2spec_summary <- aggregate(prob_S ~ timepoint + condition, data = df_W2spec_traj, FUN = mean)

ggplot(df_W2spec_traj, aes(x = timepoint, y = prob_S, color = condition)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = subject), alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_W2spec_summary, aes(group = condition), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = df_W2spec_summary, size = 4, shape = 18) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NS" = "#2171B5", "S" = "#CB181D"),
                     labels = c("NS" = "T NS", "S" = "T S")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(title = "W2-Specific Signature Score Over Time",
       subtitle = "Trained on W2 DEGs not present at D18",
       x = "Timepoint", y = "P(Sensitized)", color = "Condition") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
```

# T Post-Resection Signature Generation

```{r DESeq2 - T Post-Resection Samples (W2 and W4)}
# Subset T samples from W2 and W4
T_postres <- data_filt1 %>% dplyr::select(matches("^T_(S|NS).*_W(2|4)"))
T_postres <- round(T_postres, 0) # Make all counts integers

# Second dataframe with the condition for each T post-resection sample
T_postres_coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(T_postres), 
                      condition = ifelse(grepl("T_S", colnames(T_postres)), "S", "NS"),
                      timepoint = ifelse(grepl("W2", colnames(T_postres)),"W2", "W4"))

# Set the condition as a factor (a datatype) and list NS first so it's the baseline comparison, which is more intuitive
T_postres_coldata$condition <- factor(T_postres_coldata$condition, levels = c("NS", "S"))

T_postres_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = T_postres,
  colData = T_postres_coldata,
  design = ~ timepoint + condition)

T_postres_dds <- T_postres_dds[rowSums(counts(T_postres_dds)) > 10, ]

T_postres_dds <- DESeq(T_postres_dds)

resultsNames(T_postres_dds)
T_postres_res <- results(T_postres_dds, pAdjustMethod = "none")

summary(T_postres_res)

# Order by adjusted p-value, which is the same as the p-value if the pAdjustMethod = none above
T_postres_res_ordered <- T_postres_res[order(T_postres_res$padj), ]
view(T_postres_res_ordered %>% data.frame())

# Shrink log2FC
T_postres_resLFC <- lfcShrink(T_postres_dds, coef="condition_S_vs_NS", type="apeglm")

# Visualize!
T_postres_res_df <- as.data.frame(T_postres_res)

ggplot(T_postres_res_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(pvalue))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.025)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1) +
  xlim(-6,5)

LFc = 1 #logfold change cutoff for DEGs
pc = 0.025 #pvalue cutoff for DEGs

# Subset results by log2FC > |1| and pval < 0.1 
upT_postres <- T_postres_res_df[!is.na(T_postres_res_df$pvalue) & T_postres_res_df$padj < 0.025 & T_postres_res_df$log2FoldChange > 1,]
dnT_S_postres <- T_postres_res_df[!is.na(T_postres_res_df$pvalue) & T_postres_res_df$padj < 0.025 & T_postres_res_df$log2FoldChange < -1,]
degT_postres <- T_postres_res_df[!is.na(T_postres_res_df$pvalue) & T_postres_res_df$padj < 0.025 & abs(T_postres_res_df$log2FoldChange) > 1,]

```

``` {r Elastic Net Signature Generation - T Post-Resection Samples}
set.seed(7823)

# --- Build T Post-Resection training matrix ---
# Filter to just DEGs to improve the model
x_T_post <- t(as.matrix(T_postres)) # now: samples x genes
T_post_deg_genes <- rownames(degT_postres)
x_T_post_deg <- x_T_post[, colnames(x_T_post) %in% T_post_deg_genes, drop = FALSE]

y_T_post <- T_postres_coldata$condition # factor: "NS" (reference) vs "S"

n_T_post <- nrow(x_T_post_deg)

cat("Combined training set:\n")
print(table(y_T_post))
cat("Feature count:", ncol(x_T_post_deg), "\n\n")

# --- LOOCV on combined training set ---
n_T_post         <- nrow(x_T_post_deg)
gene_freq_T_post <- setNames(rep(0L, ncol(x_T_post_deg)), colnames(x_T_post_deg))
gene_list_T_post <- vector("list", n_T_post)
accuracy_T_post  <- rep(NA_real_, n_T_post)

for (i in seq_len(n_T_post)) {
  x_tr <- x_T_post_deg[-i, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tr <- y_T_post[-i]
  x_lo <- x_T_post_deg[i,  , drop = FALSE]
  y_lo <- y_T_post[i]

  # Recompute weights per fold so they reflect the actual training class counts
  n_ns_tr <- sum(y_tr == "NS")
  n_s_tr  <- sum(y_tr == "S")
  w_tr    <- ifelse(y_tr == "NS", 1 / n_ns_tr, 1 / n_s_tr)

  cvfit_T_post <- cv.glmnet(x_tr, y_tr,
                       weights      = w_tr,
                       family       = "binomial",
                       alpha        = 0.5,
                       nfolds       = nrow(x_tr), # LOOCV for small n
                       type.measure = "class")

  coef_T_post     <- coef(cvfit_T_post, s = "lambda.1se")
  selected_T_post <- rownames(coef_T_post)[coef_T_post[, 1] != 0 & rownames(coef_T_post) != "(Intercept)"]
  gene_list_T_post[[i]] <- selected_T_post
  gene_freq_T_post[selected_T_post] <- gene_freq_T_post[selected_T_post] + 1L

  pred_T_post        <- predict(cvfit_T_post, x_lo, s = "lambda.1se", type = "class")[, 1]
  accuracy_T_post[i] <- as.integer(pred_T_post == as.character(y_lo))
}

# Gene selection frequency
gene_freq_T_post_df <- data.frame(
  gene         = names(gene_freq_T_post),
  n_selected   = as.integer(gene_freq_T_post),
  pct_selected = round(as.integer(gene_freq_T_post) / n_T_post * 100, 1)
) |> dplyr::arrange(desc(n_selected))

# Signature: genes selected in >= 70% of LOOCV runs
signature_genes_T_post <- gene_freq_T_post_df$gene[gene_freq_T_post_df$pct_selected >= 70]

# Per-sample LOOCV results
loocv_T_post_df <- data.frame(
  sample  = rownames(x_T_post_deg),
  true    = as.character(y_T_post),
  correct = accuracy_T_post
)

cat("=== Combined LOOCV Results ===\n")
cat("Overall accuracy:", round(sum(accuracy_T_post) / n_T_post * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("NS accuracy:     ", round(mean(accuracy_T_post[y_T_post == "NS"]) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("S  accuracy:     ", round(mean(accuracy_T_post[y_T_post == "S"])  * 100, 1), "%\n\n")
print(loocv_T_post_df)
cat("\nSignature size (>= 70% selection frequency):", length(signature_genes_T_post), "\n")
print(signature_genes_T_post)

# --- Retrain final model on all samples ---
x_T_post_sig <- x_T_post_deg[, colnames(x_T_post_deg) %in% signature_genes_T_post, drop = FALSE]

# Weights inversely proportional to class frequency to correct for # NS vs # S imbalance
n_ns <- sum(y_T_post == "NS")
n_s  <- sum(y_T_post == "S")
w_T_post <- ifelse(y_T_post == "NS", 1 / n_ns, 1 / n_s)

final_fit_T_post <- cv.glmnet(x_T_post_sig, y_T_post,
                             weights      = w_T_post,
                             family       = "binomial",
                             alpha        = 0.5,
                             nfolds       = nrow(x_T_post_sig),
                             type.measure = "class")

# Show the probabilities for S for these samples
T_post_prob <- predict(final_fit_T_post, x_T_post_sig, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")[,1]
print(as.data.frame(round(T_post_prob, 3)))

```
